actual identity, credential and renewal requirements

tasks.design: Configure native requirement/expiry views and repeated identity fields in {LMS} and {HCM}, using {PARTNER_PORTAL} only for actual external credential submissions. Actual training, assessments and truthful attestations remain, with final evidence checked before separate record and submission actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Credential upkeep can repeat requirement navigation and stable identity entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native credential views and validated fields can reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Competence must be demonstrated and certification decisions belong to authorised assessors/issuers.
tasks.human_edge: The driver recognises training gaps and avoids attesting to competence not actually demonstrated.
tasks.altitude: Less credential administration; learning and competence remain human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native credential/expiry views and repeated-field configuration can support certification administration; they do not earn or issue an ambulance-driver credential.

assumptions: Employer and actual credential bodies supply current requirements; actual assessor supplies outcomes only after retained training/assessment. Driver captures new attestations and verifies all evidence. No certification success is assumed.

S3 reduces stable identity copying only; all new claims/evidence selection remain. Actual record and external-renewal branches depend on the credential; remove unused branches and reweight. Enrolment before training, if actually required, is a separately final-request checked send, not inferred from post-training outcomes and no avoided enrolment time claimed.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native functions first; existing expiry/prefill earns zero saving. Routine save and submission each retain one percent using existing final checking without added approval work.
unknowns: Which credential records and renewals are actually the driver's responsibility?
research_questions: Can native views reduce recurring checks and identity entry after complete evidence verification?

tasks.short: Report actual accident or emergency facts to authorised recipients.

steps.what: Capture actual accident or emergency facts, observations, times and sources
outputs: captured actual incident facts with sources and uncertainty

steps.what: Prepare factual incident report from actual captured observations and source records
inputs: captured actual incident facts with sources and uncertainty
actual reporting fields and recipient requirements

loop.purpose: Draft variable incident narrative from captured facts only
loop.input: actual captured observations with source, time and uncertainty
loop.output: source-linked factual narrative draft with missing items marked
loop.check: Every factual statement matches its source; preserve uncertainty, distinguish observation from hearsay and omit unsupported diagnoses or blame
loop.stop: Missing source or two failed factual checks returns narrative writing to driver
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fixed incident fields first; only variable factual prose uses a bounded draft/check loop

actual permitted hospital or law-enforcement disclosure requirements

inputs: checked final factual report and exact permitted recipient/destination

steps.what: Deliver exact checked factual report to actual authorised hospital personnel or law-enforcement official
inputs: checked final factual report and exact permitted recipient/destination
outputs: actual factual report delivered through permitted reporting channel
steps.handoff_to: authorised hospital personnel or law-enforcement official

tasks.design: Use native incident fields in {OPS_SYSTEM} before a bounded factual-prose draft in {DOCS}. The driver captures actual facts and checks the complete final report and disclosure recipient before separate save and permitted delivery through {OPS_SYSTEM} or {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual incident facts may be rewritten into variable report prose.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded source-linked draft can reduce prose composition while retaining complete human checking.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate observation, uncertainty and appropriate disclosure cannot be inferred from a report template.
tasks.human_edge: The driver distinguishes firsthand facts from assumptions and knows what was actually observed.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated report prose; factual responsibility stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a bounded draft/check loop can organise captured incident facts; it cannot establish facts, diagnose patients or authorise disclosure.

assumptions: Driver supplies actual observations, times, sources and uncertainty in retained s1; actual dispatch records have their dispatch producer and are checked rather than assumed. No automatic inference from a planned trip proves an incident fact.

S2 retains 24.5 hours of primary-fact clarification and draft checking per 100 provisional hours; s3 retains the full final review, material omissions and recipient/disclosure check. Save/send do not create new approval work. Actual organisation disclosure authority applies; no new legal authority asserted.

Scenario covers an actual written report. Immediate oral hospital/police reporting retains actual speech, removes unused drafting/record branches and reweights; do not assume every emergency creates a written prose report. Shares are provisional, not measured; native fields first, existing automatic reports earn zero saving. Shared factual capture counted once.
unknowns: Which actual reports require newly composed prose and which are oral?
research_questions: Can source-linked drafting reduce composition after complete fact, omission and disclosure checks?

already_counted.description: Primary-fact clarification and draft checking retained in s2.

incremental.description: Maintain actual incident fields and test source-faithful narrative drafting.
